ai.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir BJP accused critics of selective environmental activism, claiming political parties and leaders are using the Amarnath Yatra track widening issue to revive the Amarnath land controversy and communalise development, while asserting the project aims to improve pilgrim safety with environmental safeguards.

facts.claim: Jammu and Kashmir BJP accused critics of practising selective environmental activism
facts.quote: Coming down heavily on attempts to politicise the Amarnath Yatra track widening issue, the Jammu and Kashmir BJP on Tuesday accused critics of practising selective environmental activism and applying double standards

facts.claim: The BJP said the project concerns widening and stabilisation of vulnerable stretches of the existing Chandanwari–Amarnath track to ease congestion and improve pilgrim safety
facts.quote: The BRO has clarified that the work concerns widening and stabilisation of vulnerable stretches of the existing Chandanwari–Amarnath track to ease congestion and improve pilgrim safety

facts.claim: The BJP leader said ecological concerns cannot become an excuse for communal mobilisation or political intimidation
facts.quote: ecological concerns cannot become an excuse for communal mobilisation or political intimidation

ai.background_note: The Jammu and Kashmir BJP is opposing political attempts to link the Amarnath Yatra track widening project with the Amarnath land controversy, which they claim has been revived by political parties to communalise development in Kashmir.
